# Shubhransh Gupta

> Senior Software Engineer at Coupang (primarily iOS) based in Bengaluru, India, with 5+ years of experience building high-scale mobile architectures. Also an active open-source contributor and on-device AI systems explorer.

## Summary

Shubhransh Gupta is a Senior Software Engineer at Coupang specializing in Swift 6, SwiftUI, UIKit, Concurrency, and modular mobile architecture across large consumer-scale applications (Coupang, Navi, MakeMyTrip, Nuclei). Alongside his core iOS engineering, he actively contributes to open-source developer ecosystems and collaborates with AI researchers on on-device LLM/SLM inference, Apple Silicon Metal GPU acceleration (mlx-swift), and local-first intelligence tooling.

## Primary Mobile Engineering & Architecture

- **Core iOS & Swift**: Swift 6.0, SwiftUI, UIKit, Combine, Swift Concurrency (Actors, Tasks, Async/Await), and modular SDK development with SPM & CocoaPods.
- **Architectural Patterns**: Clean Architecture, VIPER, MVVM, and Dependency Injection (Swinject).
- **Scale & Stability**: 99.9% crash-free stability, main-thread hang optimization, and native performance instrumentation.

## Open Source & Emerging AI Research (Hobby & Systems)

- **On-Device LLMs & SLMs**: Memory-constrained inference, KV-cache optimization, and INT4 / AWQ / GGUF quantization.
- **Metal GPU & Silicon Acceleration**: Low-level kernel profiling with MLX-Swift and Metal Shading Language (MSL). Authored merged patch resolving convolution padding bounds in Metal GPU kernels (ml-explore/mlx-swift#467).
- **Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems**: Multi-model agent orchestration (Claude 3.5, Gemini, GPT-4o, Grok, Ollama) and developing local-first context filtering engines.
- **High-Concurrency Systems**: Swift 6 actor runtimes, strict data race safety, and native macOS network debugging tools.

## Key Projects & Open Source Repositories

- **toknt** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/toknt): Local-first AST context and token optimizer for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex).
- **ShubhranshProxy** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/ShubhranshProxy): Native macOS HTTP(S) proxy engine in Swift 6 with on-the-fly SSL decryption, mock breakpoints, and HAR streaming.
- **scavengers-assemble** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/scavengers-assemble): 3D isometric simulation engine orchestrating multi-agent LLM interactions in real-time.
- **findit** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/findit): Privacy-first local vector search and embedding engine for personal browsing history.
- **RebelRoutes India** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/rebelroutes-india): Multimodal anti-gridlock urban transit routing engine using FastAPI and graph theory.
- **Courier City** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/courier-city): 60 FPS 3D WebGL simulation engine with rigid-body vehicle physics, Bruno Simon diorama aesthetic, and Survey of India official boundary GIS.
- **MirrorLock** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/mirrorLock): Native macOS security lockscreen utility allowing live observation of autonomous background AI agents while securing user inputs with Touch ID.

## Upstream Contributions

- **Point-Free swift-snapshot-testing** (Active PR #1136): Enabled Swift Testing snapshot attachment recording when executing tests from the command line (`swift test --attachments-path`).
- **Tuist CLI & Build Toolchain** (Merged PR #15500, Active PRs #15568 & #15566): Handled empty warning headers & simctl JSON; resilient simulator boot lifecycle and whoami token discovery.
- **Kingfisher Swift Image Pipeline** (Active PRs #2618, #2617, #2616, #2614): Replayed cancellation on linked task shells, prefetcher cache file extension forwarding, DocC fixes, and fluent builder APIs.
- **Bloc Flutter State Management** (Active PR #4912): Implemented `prefer_multi_bloc_provider` custom lint rule.
- **Apple swift-openapi-runtime** (Merged PR #214): Added validating mutating setters to dynamic OpenAPI value containers.
- **Prebid Mobile iOS SDK** (Merged PR #1395, Active PR #1357): Populated `noAdsResponseURI` for VAST Error elements & cached URLSession connection reuse.
- **SDWebImageSwiftUI** (Active PR #368): Forwarded scale parameter in `WebImage` convenience initializers.
- **Apple mlx-swift** (Merged PR #467): Corrected convolution padding bounds calculation in Metal GPU kernels.
- **Apple swift-argument-parser** (Merged PR #961): Resolved core flag-parsing edge case with attached values in Swift CLI.
- **Apple swift-protobuf** (Merged PR #2159): Implemented deterministic ordering in TextFormat serialization for reproducible testing.
- **Google osv-scanner** (Merged PR #3049): Fixed vulnerability report filter state preservation in HTML output.
- **AppLovin SDKs** (PRs #488 & #366): Resolved ad view constraints, sizing boundaries, and mount memory leak lifecycle.
- **Fastlane** (Merged PR #30169): Guarded application-identifier prefix preservation in iOS code signing.
